JOHN H. GUESS / FOUNDER & CREATIVE

03 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE CAMERA

A creative eye.
A personal stake.

“I started out with a phone.”

Before JHG Productions, there was a camera phone, a daily route, and an eye for the stories unfolding all around me. That curiosity became a creative business built on showing people and organizations in their best light.

Today, I bring that same care to films, photography, and new ways of telling stories. Your vision matters. So does the experience of bringing it to life.
